_comment: since_year: first publication year to collect; lowering it makes the next run backfill the missing years, raising it hides older papers from the site. queries: IEEE Xplore API search variants (first one that returns records is used); optional from/to limit the years a query is used (venue launch, ISSN changes). match: regex on the returned publication_title that assigns the venue. Order of 'venues' matters for matching.

queries._comment: launched 2013; ~20k papers/year, so only keyword hits are fetched. Do not combine issn with querytext: the API then ignores the issn.
